aliases: Legends of Andor: Liberation of Rietburg
firstPlayerRule: The player considered most heroic takes the first turn.
houseFallback: If the group cannot agree, or would rather skip the comparison, agree to choose randomly. This is this site's suggested house rule.
clarifications: The manual gives no scoring system for deciding who is most heroic.
This selects the first active player. Choosing a character and carrying out the setup instructions are separate steps.
The first game's recommended character selection does not assign the opening turn to a particular hero.

internalEvidence: Complete publisher-hosted or publisher-linked PDF retrieved (the Dawn file is explicitly a shortened campaign excerpt); relevant setup, opening-turn, variant and edition pages read and visually inspected. Reviewed PDF pages: 1, 2, 4, 8. The publisher's indexed manual opens Course of play with the most-heroic-player criterion. Page 2 recommends particular characters for the first game but does not select a starter. Page 8 identifies ©2020 Thames & Kosmos and code 691746-02-181019; the filename's different product number is not substituted for that printed code. No clockwise order is claimed because the inspected source does not state it.
